benyehuda.enable: Turn on the Ben-Yehuda library? Lumen downloads it from GitHub only when you ask; after that, search and reading are local.
benyehuda.confirm: Download from the project's public-domain dump on GitHub? Nothing from your notes is sent.
benyehuda.pickAuthor: Whose works? ({count} authors in the public domain)
benyehuda.downloaded: {count} works of {author} are on this device
benyehuda.empty: The library is not on this device yet. Download it first.
benyehuda.prompt: Author, work or words (for example ביאליק בריכה)
benyehuda.downloadFirst: This work's text is not on this device. Download the works of {author} first.
benyehuda.selectInWork: Open a work from the library and select a passage first.
benyehuda.copied: Quote copied: paste it into any note
